faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All processing happens in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faq.question: What does JSON minification do?
faq.answer: JSON minification (also called json minify) removes all unnecessary whitespace, line breaks, and indentation from JSON data, making it as compact as possible. This reduces file size without changing the data.

faq.question: When should I minify JSON?
faq.answer: Minify JSON when sending data over a network, storing in a database, or embedding in URLs. Minified JSON takes less space and transfers faster.

faq.question: How much smaller does minified JSON get?
faq.answer: The size reduction depends on the original formatting. Typically, minified JSON is 30-70% smaller than pretty-printed JSON. The tool shows the exact compression ratio.

faq.question: Can I minify large JSON files?
faq.answer: Yes. Since all processing happens locally in your browser, you can minify JSON files as large as your browser's memory allows.

faq.question: What is the difference between JSON minifier and JSON formatter?
faq.answer: A JSON minifier removes all whitespace to create compact JSON. A JSON formatter adds indentation and line breaks to make JSON readable. They are opposite operations.

article.title: How to Minify JSON Online & Reduce File Size
article.content:
Why Minify JSON?

JSON minification removes all unnecessary whitespace, line breaks, and indentation from JSON data. This creates compact, single-line JSON that's ideal for production environments where file size matters.

When to Minify JSON

  • Production Deployments: Reduce payload size for faster loading
  • API Responses: Minimize network transfer time
  • Database Storage: Save storage space for large JSON documents
  • URL Parameters: Fit more data in query strings

How to Minify

  1. Paste JSON into the input field
  2. Click Minify to compress
  3. Compare sizes to see compression ratio
  4. Copy or Download the minified output

JSON Minify vs Format

  • Minify: Remove whitespace → compact JSON
  • Format: Add indentation → readable JSON

Use minify for production, format for development.

Best Practices

  • Always validate first: Ensure JSON is valid before minifying
  • Compare sizes: Check compression ratio
  • Test output: Verify minified JSON is still valid
  • Use in build process: Automate minification in CI/CD

article.title: 如何在线压缩 JSON 并减小文件大小
article.content:
为什么要压缩 JSON？

JSON 压缩会移除所有不必要的空白、换行和缩进，创建紧凑的单行 JSON。这非常适合文件大小很重要的生产环境。

何时压缩 JSON

  • 生产部署：减小负载大小以加快加载速度
  • API 响应：最小化网络传输时间
  • 数据库存储：为大型 JSON 文档节省存储空间
  • URL 参数：在查询字符串中放入更多数据

如何压缩

  1. 粘贴 JSON 到输入框
  2. 点击压缩 压缩数据
  3. 比较大小 查看压缩比率
  4. 复制或下载 压缩后的输出

JSON 压缩 vs 格式化

  • 压缩：移除空白 → 紧凑 JSON
  • 格式化：添加缩进 → 可读 JSON

生产环境用压缩，开发环境用格式化。

最佳实践

  • 先验证：确保 JSON 有效再压缩
  • 比较大小：检查压缩比率
  • 测试输出：验证压缩后的 JSON 仍然有效
  • 在构建流程中使用：在 CI/CD 中自动化压缩
